name: collabdocs
description: Realtime collaborative document editor (MERN + Yjs + Firebase)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix Server install && npm --prefix Client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,yjs,web -c cyan,magenta,green "npm --prefix Server run dev" "npm --prefix Server run dev:yjs" "npm --prefix Client start"
scripts.dev:server: concurrently -k -n api,yjs -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix Server run dev" "npm --prefix Server run dev:yjs"
